name: London Sherbet
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)

ingredients.item: ⅓ cup seeded and finely cut raisins

steps: Make syrup by boiling water and sugar ten minutes; pour over raisins, cool, and add fruit syrup and nutmeg; freeze to a mush, then add wine and whites of eggs beaten stiff, and continue freezing.
Fruit syrup may be used which has been left from canned peaches, pears, or strawberries.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
